hero.title: Clothes made for you.
hero.description: Qlozet is a Nigerian marketplace where you get clothes made to your measurements, or buy ready to wear, from independent tailors, designers and fabric sellers.

story.title: Getting clothes made should not be this hard.
paragraphs: Anyone who has had clothes made knows the routine: trips to be measured, prices that shift, and a ready date that keeps moving.
On the other side are gifted tailors, designers and fabric sellers whose work rarely reaches people beyond their street, with orders kept in notebooks and chats.
Qlozet puts both sides in one place. Your measurements come from your phone, the price and timeline are agreed before you pay, and every order is tracked all the way to your door.

values.title: Rules that look after both sides.

cards.title: Fit comes first
cards.description: Measure with your phone in about a minute. Every made-to-measure order reaches the tailor with the numbers it needs, and they can ask you if something looks off.

cards.title: Deadlines that count
cards.description: Every order has a ship-by date. If a vendor ships late, you are credited automatically, and long-overdue orders are cancelled and refunded.

cards.title: Your details stay yours
cards.description: Your measurements go only to the tailor making your order. Vendors see your first name and area, not your full contact details.

cards.title: Fair to makers
cards.description: Free to join, 10% only when they sell, and paid on a fixed schedule, 14 days after the customer pays.

flow.title: From your idea to your door

items.title: Measure
items.text: A hands-free body scan, two photos, a quick estimate, or the numbers from your tailor's book.

items.title: Design it
items.text: Pick a garment, choose the styles and a fabric in the studio, and the AI draws your outfit.

items.title: Get quotes
items.text: Send it to tailors you choose. Each one quotes a price and a timeline.

items.title: Pay a deposit
items.text: Accept the quote you like and pay the deposit. Your tailor starts work and you can chat as it's made.

items.title: Approve and receive
items.text: See photos of the finished piece, pay the balance, and follow it to your door.

cta.title: Be first in line.
cta.description: Qlozet is opening soon. Join the waitlist to hear when it does, or see what it offers if you make or sell fashion.
